title: Cleaning and Damage Fees — Upholstery Add-On by Cabin Trim
content:
The fee assessed on a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning report that is moved down at review carries an upholstery add-on read from the reported trip's ride option: Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV, whose cabins are leather, carry the leather add-on; Wayfare Comfort carries the premium cloth add-on; any other ride option carries no upholstery add-on.

The ride option is the one on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares).

| Ride option | Cabin trim | Upholstery add-on |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Black | leather | $12.00 |
| Wayfare Black SUV | leather | $12.00 |
| Wayfare Comfort | premium cloth | $6.00 |
| Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green or Wayfare XL | — | none |

The add-on is a fixed dollar amount added to the fee assessed at the moved-down level, whatever the level and whatever the number of seats requested.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A report on a Wayfare XL trip carries no upholstery add-on, because Wayfare XL is not one of the trims named; the same report on a Wayfare Black SUV trip carries $12.00.
